result.title: Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models
result.summary: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 trajectory replay：不做样本回放，而是让更新后的速度场沿历史轨迹匹配冻结的历史速度场、同时兼顾新任务速度场，并以稳定性-弹性系数加权，配合均值速度蒸馏，用于类增量图像生成与两个生物扰动建模场景。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在轨迹层面对冻结模型速度场做蒸馏并用稳定性-弹性系数加权」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的持续更新、轨迹级监督与少步生成提供可核查的方法线索；但场景属持续生成建模，迁移性需自行判断。
